title: O Thou Who Camest from Above
description: O Thou Who Camest from Above in Tonic Solfa to HEREFORD: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: Charles Wesley published these words in Short Hymns on Select Passages of the Holy Scriptures (1762). The tune HEREFORD is by Samuel Sebastian Wesley (1872); it repeats the last line of each verse.
underlay: O Thou who cam-est from a-bove__, The pure ce-les-tial fire to im-part, Kin-dle a flame of sa-cred love Up-on_ the mean al__-tar of my heart, Up-on the mean__ al-tar_ of my heart_.

lines: O Thou who camest from above,
The pure celestial fire to impart,
Kindle a flame of sacred love
Upon the mean altar of my heart.
There let it for Thy glory burn
And trembling to its source return,
In humble prayer and fervent praise.
To work and speak and think for Thee;
Still let me guard the holy fire,
And still stir up Thy gift in me.
Ready for all Thy perfect will,
My acts of faith and love repeat,
Till death Thy endless mercies seal,
